learner_operation: Identify the augmented matrix of three proportional equations, normalize a nonzero pivot row and eliminate multiples; choose the row-equivalent RREF. Moderate additionally isolates x as an affine expression in free y,z. Numerical normalization, not a label/sign template, must determine correctness.

fixed_features.feature: Consistent rank-one three-equation system, one normalized pivot, two zero rows
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 3950 explicitly teaches one-pivot 3x3 systems; inconsistent or higher-rank systems change the mathematical task.

fixed_features.feature: Five-choice radio, one mathematically correct candidate
fixed_features.justification: All 16 practice fields use this contract. A unique RREF is a theorem (Tutorial 3161), and each represented affine solution plane has one complete valid choice.

fixed_features.feature: x is the normalized pivot, y and z remain free
fixed_features.justification: This specialization isolates pivot normalization and removal of proportional rows. Leading-zero columns would add pivot-location/free-variable case selection to the intended short workload. This conservative x-pivot subskill is supported by all target practice questions; no claim is made to cover arbitrary pivot-column detection.

fixed_features.feature: All ordinary options share signs, rank and one-pivot shape
fixed_features.justification: This is an authored numerical-comparison exercise: these common features prevent shape/sign elimination from replacing quotient calculation. Candidate membership is independently varied; source replay still retains complete observed error banks.
